chapter_level.guidance: Every કડી closes on 'પ્રભુ હે...' and the whole ગીત is one address to 'પ્રભુ' asking for inner strength (જોર, તેજ, બળ, રસ, ગર્જના, સ્નેહશક્તિ), so the risk runs through all six topics alike rather than any one of them — explanation and real_life_example must stay literature about ભાવ (humility, self-betterment, the wish to matter beyond oneself), never theology: do not name or imply which tradition's 'પ્રભુ' this is (the poem itself never does), never turn a field into an instruction to pray a particular way, and keep any recall or example anchored in the child's own effort (studying hard, helping at home) rather than in ritual or a specific act of worship.
